import bpy, os, base64, math
from mathutils import Vector
base=bpy.data.objects['OFICIAL | Entrada superior | lintel']
theta=base.rotation_euler.z
ex=Vector((math.cos(theta),math.sin(theta),0.0))
ey=Vector((-math.sin(theta),math.cos(theta),0.0))
origin=Vector((base.location.x,base.location.y,0.0))
target=origin+Vector((0,0,47.2))
cam_obj=bpy.data.objects.get('CHATGPT | camera preview fachada')
if cam_obj:
    bpy.data.objects.remove(cam_obj,do_unlink=True)
cam_data=bpy.data.cameras.new('CHATGPT | camera preview fachada')
cam_obj=bpy.data.objects.new('CHATGPT | camera preview fachada',cam_data)
bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(cam_obj)
cam_obj.location=target+ex*25.0+Vector((0,0,0.5))
cam_obj.rotation_euler=(target-cam_obj.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler()
cam_data.lens=58
cam_data.clip_start=0.1
cam_data.clip_end=500
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
scene=bpy.context.scene
oldcam=scene.camera
old=(scene.render.filepath,scene.render.resolution_x,scene.render.resolution_y,scene.render.resolution_percentage,scene.render.image_settings.file_format,scene.render.image_settings.quality,scene.render.engine)
root=r'C:\mcp-blender\blender_bridge\previews'
os.makedirs(root,exist_ok=True)
out=os.path.join(root,'collab_facade_front_clean.jpg')
try:
    scene.camera=cam_obj
    scene.render.engine='BLENDER_WORKBENCH'
    scene.display.shading.light='STUDIO'
    scene.display.shading.color_type='MATERIAL'
    scene.display.shading.show_shadows=True
    scene.display.shading.show_cavity=True
    scene.render.filepath=out
    scene.render.resolution_x=320
    scene.render.resolution_y=240
    scene.render.resolution_percentage=100
    scene.render.image_settings.file_format='JPEG'
    scene.render.image_settings.quality=22
    bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
finally:
    scene.camera=oldcam
    scene.render.filepath,scene.render.resolution_x,scene.render.resolution_y,scene.render.resolution_percentage,scene.render.image_settings.file_format,scene.render.image_settings.quality,scene.render.engine=old
with open(out,'rb') as f:
    b64=base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode('ascii')
with open(os.path.join(root,'collab_facade_front_clean_b64.txt'),'w',encoding='ascii') as f:
    f.write(b64)
print(f'CLEAN_FRONT bytes={os.path.getsize(out)} base64={len(b64)} camera={tuple(round(v,3) for v in cam_obj.location)}')
